# FDG9028

> DO NOT use the `in` (ref readonly) parameter modifier in a virtual or abstract Async method.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 9.2.2 Task-Based Async Pattern.

## How it is checked

- Check: fdg (full coverage)
- Diagnostics: FDG9028
- Automatic fix: not applied automatically (the fix can break callers)
- Severity: library warning, application none, test none
- Status: verified

Message: Remove the in modifier from the parameter '{0}' of the virtual asynchronous method '{1}'

Library only: the reason given is the developers who extend the type, who cannot use the async keyword in an override. FDG9028 reports an in or ref readonly parameter of an externally visible method that returns a task-like type (as for FDG9020) or IAsyncEnumerable&lt;T> and is virtual or abstract, or of an interface method. Overrides and interface implementations take their signature from another member and are not reported. Changing the modifier changes the public signature, so the fix is breaking; there is no code fix.
